title: [CON2-8] Broadcast channels have no MLS group, but the example and the creation steps give them one
description: Review finding CON2-8: Broadcast channels have no MLS group, but the example and the creation steps give them one (lens CON2). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:97, :351, :242. Fix: The broadcast entry of the §3.3 example (lines 90-98, `"mode": "broadcast"`) carries `"mlsGroupID"` at line 97, contradicting §3.2 ("None (§5.2.1.4)") and §5.2.1.4. §3.6 step 1 gives "for each initial channel, a `channelID` and an MLS group". Remove line 97's `mlsGroupID`; step 1: "a `channelID` and, for a channel that has one (§3.2), an MLS group"; field index line 242: add "absent on `broadcast`". (§3.6 Create at :359 already says "for a channel that has one".) Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
